comment: Synthetic fixture for section-level retrieval and token-aware delivery (scripts/eval_retrieval.py --config). Every note and prompt is invented. units: one prompt each, scored by rank (recall@k, MRR over search_domains), by injection, and by whether the injected text already holds the answer phrase; a miss that injected the note is charged one follow-up read. sessions: prompts in one session through the real prompt hook.

notes.title: Token refresh design
notes.body:
Token refresh happens in one place: the auth gateway renews every session.

## Why
Each mobile and web client used to retry expired sessions on its own, so a single outage produced a storm of duplicate renewal calls.

## Alternatives considered
- Per-client refresh with jittered retries: rejected, it kept the duplicated logic in every app.
- A shared client SDK: rejected because the iOS release cycle is too slow to ship fixes.

notes.title: Event publishing design
notes.body:
Domain events are written to an outbox table and published by a poller.

## Why
Writing the event in the same database transaction as the change means nothing is lost if the process crashes before publishing.

## Alternatives considered
- Kafka: rejected; operating a broker cluster costs more than our event volume justifies.
- Direct HTTP webhooks from request handlers: rejected, a failed call drops the event.

notes.title: Signing key rotation
notes.body:
Rotate the JWT signing keys every quarter.

## When to use
At the start of each quarter, or the same day a key may have leaked.

## Steps
1. Run `keyctl rotate --all --confirm` on the vault host.
2. Restart the gateway with `svc restart gateway`.
3. Check that `keyctl status` lists the new key id.

## Roll back
Run `keyctl rollback --to previous` and restart the gateway again; tokens signed with the new key stop validating.

notes.title: Payroll export crash
notes.body:
The nightly payroll export crashed on large months.

## Cause
The CSV writer raised `MemoryError: cannot allocate 2147483648 bytes` because it buffered the whole month in memory.

## Fix
Stream rows in pages with `export --page-size 5000`; memory now stays flat.

## How to check
The export log ends with `pages written` and no traceback.

notes.title: Warehouse sync service
notes.body:
The warehouse sync service copies stock levels from every warehouse into the central inventory database.

## Components
A fetcher per warehouse, a normalizer and a writer that upserts rows into inventory.stock.

## Scheduling
The import job runs every 15 minutes from the cron host; a run that overlaps the previous one is skipped.

## Clock handling
Timestamps from the Osaka warehouse arrive in JST and are converted to UTC before comparison; the converter lives in `tz_bridge.normalize()`.

## Retries
A failed fetch is retried three times with a two minute pause, then the warehouse is marked stale on the dashboard.

## Monitoring
The sync dashboard shows lag per warehouse; an alert fires when any lag passes one hour.

notes.title: Database backup schedule
notes.body:
Postgres is backed up nightly at 02:00 UTC to cold storage.

## Details
- Restores are tested monthly by restoring into the staging cluster.
- Backups are kept for 35 days.

notes.title: Log retention period
notes.body:
Application logs are kept for 14 days.

## Why
Disk on the old log host was limited.

notes.title: Log retention period, revised
notes.body:
Application logs are now kept for 90 days in the log archive.

## Why
Audits need three months of history; archive storage is cheap.

notes.title: Feature flag naming
notes.body: Feature flags are named team.area.feature, all lower case, for example billing.invoices.bulk_export.

notes.title: Office plant watering
notes.body: The office plants are watered on Mondays and Thursdays by whoever opens the office.

notes.title: Team lunch rotation
notes.body: Team lunch rotates between three restaurants; the organizer books a table for Friday.

notes.title: Coffee machine descaling
notes.body: The coffee machine is descaled every second week with the tablets in the kitchen drawer.
